'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Zach Tollefson LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Zach Tollefson]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|VB5-L-wellhandlethis-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WHT(V)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
